name: Absorb Strength
body:
School transmutation [evil]; Level cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, medium 3, psychic 4, shaman 3 sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (at least an ounce of a dead creature’s flesh)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 minute/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

The caster consumes a portion of another creature’s flesh as they finish this spell, gaining one quarter of the creature’s Strength score as an enhancement bonus to their Strength score, and one-quarter of the creature’s Constitution score as an enhancement bonus to their Constitution score.

The flesh must be from a creature that died no more than one week prior to the casting of the spell. The caster can gain a bonus to either score of no more than 1/2 their caster level from this spell.
